items.title: Bill Bourgeois Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: Thurman Teague bass, and Benny Pollack, because Frank was playing with Benny Pollack and so was Thurman Teague.

ctx.x: Now up in New York, who was Sharky using for you one day?

Nobody. I'm the first one he used. Because he got the job at Nix you see. He had some record dates and Fazola played with him on the record dates, the first dates. Because I went to the rehearsal, I mean to the recording sessions with him. And I even spoke on one record and didn't play. What did you say? Somebody said, Benny Pollack got the date for Sharky and he played drums. And the opening lines was, hey Sharky, what you doing up here in New York? And I answered, I said, man can't you see I'm trying to play…
